why: Which cities count as a country's capital, and in what order. `overrides` is the editorial call and is used verbatim: unlike a fetched capital it does not pass through the `capitals` table in `countries.<locale>.json`, which is why the entries here are already spelled the way a player sees them. `missingUpstream` is the opposite — the capital of a country the fetcher has no record of at all, given as upstream text and translated like any other. Where a capital is disputed or a country has several, the reason a player is shown is the note filed under the same code in `notes.<locale>.json`.
